From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision playback + rollforward checklist

Team —

Thanks for a focused sync this morning. I captured the decisions and the immediate rollforward asks in the attached checklist (spreadsheet) and a short decision-log PDF. This thread is to close the loop on a couple of exec asks and to make sure owners have the right timelines. Action items I need confirmed by EOD Monday: 

1) Model pin for Hosted: confirm target variant (redwood-3b-q8_0) and whether we can accept the 1–2% quality delta for a 25% cost reduction. Owner: Marissa.
2) Dedicated burst policy exception: approve temporary extra pool for Oct launch (SLA impact assessment required). Owner: Vivek.
3) Roadmap reorder: move "optimize prefix cache" from Q4 to Q3 if burst exception approved. Owner: Karthik.
4) Exec ask: prepare a 2-slide summary for Tuesday leadership sync showing cost delta + rollback plan. Owner: Ben.

Please reply with any changes to owners or timelines. If you can’t hit EOD Monday, call out the blocker. I’ll compile the final checklist and route to Execs on Tuesday morning.

Attachments: 20260918-rollforward-checklist.xlsx; decision-log-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Product Ops
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision playback + rollforward checklist

Laura —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick clarifications on item 1 (model pin):
- The quality delta you noted is accurate for our internal evals on the customer prompt set; for Acme's conversational latency profile, the cost per 1k tokens drops ~23%.
- Risk: we will need to run the A/B for 48 hours on a small percentage before full switch; I recommend a 5% canary starting Oct 4.

I updated the spreadsheet (tab: model-pin) with the A/B plan and proposed metrics (latency p95, error-rate, nps-like quality score). No change to owner — I’ll own the rollout coordination.

Also added a column for fallbacks (auto-route to redwood-3b-fp16).

Marissa
Sr. Product Manager, Serving
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Folks —

On item 2 (Dedicated burst policy exception): I ran the initial capacity/impact calc with infra. TL;DR: we can provision an additional burst pool for the Oct launch but it will consume ~12% of available capacity and will require an exception to the current burst budget.

Immediate asks from my side:
- Finance needs an estimate of incremental monthly cost for a 30-day period. (Ben, can you get procurement guidance?)
- SRE wants the exact failover plan documented — I dropped a stub in the Drive doc (link below).

If finance signs off, I’ll put the request into the Dedicated queue and aim for procurement approval by Sep 30. That gives Marissa two weeks for the canary.

Vivek
